title: WATCH: Trump says tariffs could replace income tax | 2026 State of the Union
summary: State of the Union excerpt: tariffs took in hundreds of billions from countries that were ripping off the US with no inflation and tremendous growth, will survive the Supreme Court ruling, and could replace the income tax.

assertions.quote: Countries that were ripping us off for decades are now paying us hundreds of billions of dollars
There was no inflation, tremendous growth
Donald Trump called the economy correctly and 22 Nobel Prize winners in economics didn't. They got a totally wrong.
almost all countries and corporations want to keep the deal that they already made

verdicts.note: Many partners signalled they would keep their deals, but the EU froze implementation of its side after the ruling.

assertions.quote: the tariffs paid by foreign countries will, like in the past, substantially replaced the modern day system of income tax

verdicts.note: Tariffs raise roughly $200-300 billion a year against about $2.5 trillion of individual income tax; imports are too small a base.
